name: Twilight Witches
source:
Dan Martin is a former marine.
Not willing to come back in his childhood city, he settles in a small town in the middlewest.
He starts a new life as owner of a motorcycle workshop until a day when...​

translation:
丹・馬丁曾是一名海軍陸戰隊員。
他不願回到成長的城市，便在中西部的一座小鎮定居。
他開了一家機車行，開始新的生活。直到某一天……
